outcome: umbilical cord blood steroid hormone profiles
cohort: This study included 48 pregnant women without preconception obesity, divided into hyperandrogenic PCOS with COC treatment, hyperandrogenic PCOS, and non-PCOS control groups, with outcomes measured in their newborns' umbilical cord blood.
finding: Oestrogen, progesterone, and corticosteroids concentrations were elevated in umbilical cord blood from hyperandrogenic women with PCOS receiving COC, and up-regulated lipid metabolites were enriched in pathways involving atherosclerosis and cholesterol metabolism.
